breakdown_rule: The headline target status is the overall one. Per-court, per-stratum and proceeding-specific statuses are reported for the owner; whether 'met' must also hold per breakdown is an owner decision (PROTOCOL v1.1 s.6.4). Party-specific is descriptive.
headline_rule: headline status = worse of the full-sample status and the status without the PRIMARY pre-exposed subset (PROTOCOL_C13 v1.1 s.6)
status_note: AUTOMATED_CANDIDATE_NOT_VERIFIED outputs scored against AI-coded reference annotations unless the store manifest says otherwise

gold_party_specific.note: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY (PROTOCOL v1.1 s.6.3): too few expected gold units; no pass or fail is claimed

uncodable.rule: kept in the sample, outside scored denominators, reported here and as coverage_counting_uncodable_items_as_not_covered; never replaced
